title: LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation
abstract: arXiv:2611.03308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM's access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo

translated_title: 大语言模型在MS/MS结构解析的分布外泛化中依赖专业工具
translated_abstract: 近期有报道称，一个前沿语言模型能够在不使用工具的情况下解决一维NMR结构解析问题。我们探讨这种能力是否可以迁移到从头解析设定下的串联质谱（MS/MS）中，即模型必须直接从谱图提出结构，而没有候选列表或参考库。为了将推理能力与记忆能力区分开，我们基于MassSpecGym构建了一个包含100个分析物的基准，并根据每个分析物的文本足迹将其划分为分布内（文献中有充分记载）和分布外（基本无记载）两部分。我们保持模型、测试框架和输出格式不变，仅改变LLM对领域专用工具的访问权限。在没有工具的情况下，前沿LLM在分布内达到52%的Top-1准确率，但在分布外仅有2%。只有访问从头结构生成器才能提高分布外准确率，将其提升至最高38%的Top-1，且由此产生的智能体优于独立的从头结构……
tldr: 前沿大语言模型在MS/MS从头结构解析中，分布内可达52%准确率但分布外骤降至2%，表明其泛化能力主要依赖记忆；唯有引入从头结构生成器等专业工具才能将分布外准确率提升至38%。
en_tdlr: Frontier LLMs achieve 52% Top-1 accuracy on in-distribution MS/MS structure elucidation but only 2% out-of-distribution, and only access to de novo structure generator tools lifts OOD accuracy to 38%, showing that LLM generalization depends on specialist tools rather than pure reasoning.
